items.name: VERK VII 2025
items.information:
**The competition starts at 8:15 pm and ends at 2 am.**

Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor.

**Kilpailu alkaa klo 20:15 ja päättyy klo 2.**

Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua.
Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija.

items.name: Singapore Mofunland Cruise 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--8c91d91f6e6b4e145f3a55186632ffd6d57b733e/MOFUNLAND%20CRUISE%20OPEN%202025%20(2)%202.png)

This competition will take place aboard a cruise ship!
The location is listed as Marina Bay Cruise Centre due to the ship departing from there. The competition itself will take place in the Zodiac Theater on the Cruise on the 3rd day of the cruise, which is 26 June 2025. The Cruise departs from Marina Bay Cruise Centre on 24 June 2025.
Please head to the [competition website](https://www.mofunland.com/how-to-register-for-mofunland-cruise-2025) for more details

items.name: Michigan Mini 32 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODI1NzUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--96e3a34f536321dc80ae3ba52f8091ed7a983076/Michigan%20Mini%2032%20Comp%20Page.png)

**This competition takes place on a Thursday night!**

Join us for another one of our popular mini competitions!  Both newcomers and experienced competitors are welcome, register quickly to reserve your spot!

Free parking is available on site.
